Title: Steering: H2 priorities

## Notes

## Summary

Åsa flipped the H2 order: shift swaps ships first, payroll export moves to Q1. Her reasoning: Café Nord's Q2 QBR plus two more prospect calls this month all raised staff-driven shift swaps unprompted, all hitting the same September turnover wall, and payroll export doesn't even help Café Nord. The May reasoning for payroll-first (two accounts with a hard date) no longer holds.

This reverses [[decisions/2026-05-18-h2-order-payroll-first]].

Open items that came out of it:
- Rebecca will re-scope SCH-240 (the manager-approval story, overtime check included) and give a real estimate, not a ship date, by "next Friday" (she and I confirmed the date out loud as the 24th).
- The swap notification shows the requesting colleague's name and phone number to whoever could pick up the shift. Rebecca flagged this as a GDPR gap nobody has reviewed with Henrik; that's already tracked ([[todos/henrik-review-swap-notifications]]).
- A fourth swap story is missing: nobody gets notified when their own shift is picked up in an approved swap. Rebecca will make sure it's filed under SCH-231 this week.
- Fjord Sports is standing under the old Q4 payroll date and now needs a new one, since export is sliding to Q1.
- Marcus gets one line for Café Nord: "before September," same as the QBR, nothing more specific until Rebecca's estimate lands.
- Offline mode stays declined; Åsa wants it kept in writing as a not-doing line on the roadmap page (it already is).
- I'm on the hook for flipping the roadmap page and commenting on the payroll export epic today.

Åsa closed by asking, pointedly, whether any of this gets written down anywhere.
<<<END_EXTERNAL_MATERIAL id=8737fa54>>>
Åsa reordered H2 priorities to tackle shift swaps before payroll export based on customer feedback about September turnover, moving payroll to Q1 and creating several follow-up tasks for the team.
